analysis.reply_text: First, move closer to the router and watch if the drops stop; if they do, it’s likely a signal or interference issue. Next, power-cycle the router and modem by unplugging them for about 30 seconds, then plug them back in and wait for everything to fully reconnect. After that, on your device, toggle Wi-Fi off and back on, then forget the network and reconnect by entering the password again. Then, check if other devices on the same network also drop; if they don’t, update your device’s Wi-Fi drivers or operating system. Next, log into the router’s admin page and update its firmware, and if you can, try changing the Wi-Fi channel or band. Finally, reduce interference by moving the router away from walls and appliances, and if the issue continues, contact your internet provider to check the line and account status.
